subject: INLA Doesn't Run with Larger Dataset

messages.author: 3d1664af77fb43cc
messages.subject: INLA Doesn't Run with Larger Dataset
parts:
Hello fellow-INLAers,

I am running a Poisson mixed model with about 80,000 observations. I am able to run the model when I limit it to the first 60,000 observations or the last 60,000 observations, but I get an error when I try to include all of the observations (or a set of 70K). I have set reasonable priors and I have tried using diagonal = 100K, diagonal = 1000, diagonal = 100, diagonal = 10. None of these work. I am using control.inla = list(int.strategy='eb', strategy='gaussian', correct = TRUE).

This is the error I am seeing:

Number of non-zero weights [10]
Lincomb = idx weight
81780 1.0000000000
82110 1.0000000000
82118 1.0000000000
82119 0.0000000000
82120 0.0000000000
82121 1.0000000000
82122 0.0000000000
82123 0.0000000000
82124 0.0000000000
82125 0.0000000000
output:
summary=[1]
return.marginals=[1]
nquantiles=[3]  [ 0.025 0.5 0.975 ]
ncdf=[0]  [ ]
section=[444] name=[lincomb.1763USD] type=[LINCOMB]
inla_parse_lincomb...
secname = [lincomb.1763USD]
filename [C:/Users/Me/AppData/Local/TempError in inla.inlaprogram.has.crashed() : 
  The inla-program exited with an error. Unless you interupted it yourself, please rerun with verbose=TRUE and check the output carefully.
  If this does not help, please contact the developers at <he...@r-inla.org>.

I have also tried running this without the linear combinations and I am seeing the same issue.

Any pointers would be appreciated! Thank you.
